invariants.formal_statement: A failed Direct (rbl) payout produces NO reversal row and NO Shared-style reversal journal; the payout stays failed.
invariants.setup: Fresh Direct merchant B, feature parity with M2.
invariants.action: Journeys B (immediate) and D (pending->failure): bank returns failed.
invariants.expected_effect: payout.status=failed, reversals count=0, no da_payout_reversed journal.
invariants.negative_control: Shared (nodal) account: bank failed remaps to REVERSED with a reversal row (V18, test_v18).

invariants.formal_statement: A processed Direct payout yields exactly two balanced DA journals (da_payout_processed + _recon); replaying the recon/payout_update path creates NO additional journal ((transactor_id,transactor_event) unique).
invariants.setup: Journey A success on merchant A (DA onboarded).
invariants.action: Replay the payout_update / delayed status (journeys C and F).
invariants.expected_effect: journal count stays 2; (transactor_id, transactor_event) unique for the merchant.
invariants.negative_control: Without ledger layer-2 ValidateJournalExist the replay would write 4 journals.

invariants.formal_statement: An in-flight reservation transitions live -> awaiting_balance_refresh -> released AT MOST ONCE; re-running the reconciler does not double-release or duplicate the item.
invariants.setup: Journey A processed payout on merchant A.
invariants.action: Read the reservation set after processing and again after a reconciler pass (journey F re-read).
invariants.expected_effect: at most one reservation item per payout; state monotonic (no second release).
invariants.negative_control: A double terminal-hook would remove/decrement the counter twice.

invariants.formal_statement: A duplicate statement / replayed recon does not debit the merchant ledger balance a second time: no additional debit entries appear and the DA journal count is unchanged.
invariants.setup: Journey A success + journey F duplicate statement on merchant A.
invariants.action: Re-ingest the identical CSV and re-fire the payout_update (journey F).
invariants.expected_effect: no new BAS row, DA journal count stays 2 (so no second set of debit entries).
invariants.negative_control: Absent dedup, a second da_payout_processed would double the merchant-balance debit.

invariants.formal_statement: For a successful Direct payout the DA journal entries sum to zero (sum_debit==sum_credit per journal) AND the modeled money-state is conserved across balance/reservation/ledger (reservation held==amount during pending, released on terminal; ledger merchant-balance debit==payout amount).
invariants.action: Sum ledger entries per journal; compare reservation-held and ledger merchant-balance debit against the payout amount.
invariants.expected_effect: every journal balanced; reservation held during pending == amount; da_payout_processed debit on Merchant Balance == amount.
invariants.negative_control: An unbalanced journal or a reservation/ledger amount != payout amount breaks conservation.

evidence_source.modeled_conservation: reservation held (==amount, released on terminal) offsets the ledger merchant-balance debit; DA journals balanced (sum_debit==sum_credit) -> net ledger movement is zero-sum across DA sub-accounts

invariants.formal_statement: Statement->payout matching uses the correct tuple: same merchant_id, account_number, currency, amount and statement-detail; the wrong-amount statement is NOT matched.
invariants.setup: Journey A (positive) + journey G2 wrong-amount (negative control) on their merchants.
invariants.action: Read the linked BAS row (A) and the wrong-amount BAS row (G2).
invariants.expected_effect: A: BAS.merchant_id==mid, account_number==acct, currency==INR, amount==payout amount, linked to the correct payout. G2: wrong-amount row stays external, unlinked, no journal.
invariants.negative_control: G2 wrong-amount statement is the negative control (must NOT link).
invariants.fidelity: real-worker statement + real PS link; substitute xas decision
